media.title: L’Informateur de Seine, 30 March 1934 — advertisement for Mariage à responsabilité limitée
media.description: Display advertisement in L’Informateur de Seine, 30 March 1934, for Mariage à responsabilité limitée, the French-language version of Ehe mit beschränkter Haftung, billing Florelle above the title and crediting the music to Kaper and Jurmann.
media.altText: French newspaper advertisement billing Florelle in Mariage à responsabilité limitée, with the music credited to Kaper and Jurmann.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The clipping is a display advertisement for the French version of the film, set in display type without an illustration. The archive treats a trade advertisement of this kind as a protected anonymous work, as it does the Kinematograph advertisements of 1930; printed in L’Informateur de Seine on 30 March 1934, its French term of seventy years from publication ran out at the end of 2004, so it was protected on 1 January 1996 and the URAA restored United States copyright to the end of 2029. Gallica supplies the digitised page under conditions governed by French law, which exclude documents protected by a third party’s copyright and leave reuse in another country to the user.
